choices.why: This extendable rectangular brown-black table seats six every day and stretches for eight, and its simple dark wood fits the space between the peninsula and the stairs.
These are the only chairs clearly upholstered in grey fabric, and their black legs match the table and the stair newel posts.
A large black dome with a brass detail gives a classic yet current look and adds warmth over the table without competing with the white kitchen pendants.
This 160 cm walnut sideboard fits the stair wall, and its warm grain echoes the wood floor and the banister.

answer.why: The dark wood of the table and the black legs of the chairs tie in with the stair banister and the kitchen cabinets, the grey upholstery softens the set, and the walnut and the brass on the pendant add the warmth asked for against the cream walls.
